title: Corner C3 - Megaboard RPG Visual Spec
summary: The RPG tactical menu. Party screen, quest log, mission feed. Pokemon meets business intelligence. Dark theme, game typography, HP bars.
content:
Corner C3: Megaboard RPG Visual Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. This is the power-user view. Make it feel like you're commanding a raid party, not reading a spreadsheet.

The Vision

The Megaboard is where Corner stops pretending to be a normal dashboard. This is pure RPG. Dark theme, game typography, character cards with HP bars, quest logs with status indicators. The user who opens this view should feel like they just opened the menu screen of a tactical RPG.

Design references:

  • Pokemon party screen (6 character slots with health bars)
  • Final Fantasy XV character stats screen (dark, detailed, lots of data)
  • Fire Emblem unit overview (grid of character cards with role/class info)
  • Linear.app (for the clean engineering dashboard underneath the RPG skin)

The key tension: RPG aesthetic but NOT cosplay. The data is real business data. The game layer makes it engaging, not confusing. A CPA should understand "this agent is at 85% utilization" whether it says that literally or shows an HP bar at 85%.

Color System (Megaboard-Specific)

The Megaboard has its own dark theme that's darker and more saturated than the base Corner palette.

Token Value Usage
bg-primary #070B14 Page background, deepest layer
bg-card #0C1120 Card backgrounds
bg-card-hover #111828 Card hover state
bg-card-active #141E30 Active/selected card
border-subtle rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) Card borders, dividers
border-medium rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) Hover borders
text-primary #F0ECE6 Primary text
text-secondary #8A847C Secondary text, labels
text-muted #4A5060 Timestamps, tertiary info
accent-gold #C9A84C XP, level badges, headers
accent-orange #E85D26 Primary accent, active states
hp-green #22C55E High utilization (>70%)
hp-yellow #F59E0B Medium utilization (40-70%)
hp-red #EF4444 Low utilization (<40%) or blocked
hp-empty #1A2030 Unfilled portion of HP bar

Typography (Megaboard-Specific)

The Megaboard uses a slightly different type hierarchy to feel more "game menu."

Element Font Size Weight Color Notes
Section title Syne 14px 800 accent-gold Uppercase, letter-spacing 0.1em
Character name Space Grotesk 16px 700 text-primary
Character role JetBrains Mono 10px 500 text-secondary Uppercase, letter-spacing 0.12em
Level badge JetBrains Mono 11px 800 accent-gold
Quest text Space Grotesk 13px 400 text-primary
Quest status JetBrains Mono 9px 600 varies Uppercase
Stat label JetBrains Mono 8px 500 text-muted Uppercase, letter-spacing 0.15em
Stat value JetBrains Mono 14px 700 text-primary Monospaced for alignment
Event text Space Grotesk 12px 400 text-secondary
Event timestamp JetBrains Mono 9px 400 text-muted

Desktop Layout (>= 1024px)

Overall Composition

Three sections arranged in a dashboard grid:

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [CORNER.]   [Game]  [Checklist]  [MEGABOARD]                       [v]  |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                          |
|  +------------------------------------+  +---------------------------+  |
|  |       P A R T Y   S C R E E N      |  |    Q U E S T   L O G     |  |
|  |                                      |  |                         |  |
|  | [Card] [Card] [Card] [Card]         |  | [Quest Item]             |  |
|  | [Card] [Card] [Card] [Card]         |  | [Quest Item]             |  |
|  | [Card] [Card] [Card] [Card]         |  | [Quest Item]             |  |
|  |                                      |  | [Quest Item]             |  |
|  +------------------------------------+  | [Quest Item]             |  |
|                                           | [Quest Item]             |  |
|  +------------------------------------+  |                         |  |
|  |     M I S S I O N   F E E D        |  +---------------------------+  |
|  |                                      |                                |
|  | [Event] [Event] [Event]             |                                |
|  | [Event] [Event] [Event]             |                                |
|  +------------------------------------+                                |
|                                                                          |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Agent] [text input.................................] [Send] [^]          |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Grid Layout:

  • CSS Grid: grid-template-columns: 1fr 340px
  • grid-template-rows: auto 1fr
  • Gap: 16px
  • Padding: 20px 24px
  • Max-height: viewport minus top bar (48px) and chat bar (56px)
  • Overflow-y: auto on the entire grid

Left column:

  • Party Screen (top)
  • Mission Feed (bottom)

Right column:

  • Quest Log (full height of the right column, scrollable independently)

Party Screen

Section Header

  • Title: "PARTY" in Syne 800, 14px, accent-gold, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.1em
  • Right side: total team XP counter (C3: placeholder "-- XP" since XP UI is C4+)
  • Border-bottom: 1px solid border-subtle
  • Padding-bottom: 12px
  • Margin-bottom: 16px

Agent Character Card

A grid of cards, one per agent. This is the Pokemon party screen.

Grid: CSS Grid, 4 columns at 1440px, 3 columns at 1024px. Gap: 12px.

Card Container:

  • Width: fills grid cell
  • Height: 140px
  • Background: bg-card
  • Border: 1px solid border-subtle
  • Border-radius: 10px
  • Padding: 14px
  • Cursor: pointer
  • Transition: all 150ms ease

Card Hover:

  • Background: bg-card-hover
  • Border-color: agentColor at 20%
  • Box-shadow: 0 0 12px agentColor at 8%
  • Transform: translateY(-2px)

Card Click:

  • Navigates to individual agent deep-dive (same Megaboard but showing that agent's full stats)

Card Layout (vertical stack):

+------------------------------------------+
| [Avatar 36px]  Bobby          LV 7  [*]  |
|                Web Dev                    |
|                                           |
| HP [============================----]  85%|
|                                           |
| > Rebuild /v2 to audit standard           |
+------------------------------------------+

  1. Top Row: Identity

    • SpriteAvatar: 36px, agentColor border
    • Agent name: Space Grotesk 700, 16px, text-primary
    • Agent role: JetBrains Mono 500, 10px, text-secondary, uppercase
    • Level badge (right side):
      • "LV [N]" in JetBrains Mono 800, 11px, accent-gold
      • Background: accent-gold at 10%
      • Border: 1px solid accent-gold at 20%
      • Border-radius: 4px
      • Padding: 2px 6px
      • For C3: show "LV --" (placeholder, XP data accumulates but no UI yet)
    • Status indicator (far right):
      • 8px circle
      • Active: agentColor, pulsing
      • Idle: #6B7280
      • Blocked: #EF4444
      • Done: #22C55E

  2. HP/Utilization Bar

    • Label (left): "HP" in JetBrains Mono 500, 8px, text-muted, uppercase
    • Bar container: full width, height 8px, border-radius 4px, bg hp-empty
    • Fill: width = utilization %, border-radius 4px

      • 70%: hp-green

      • 40-70%: hp-yellow
      • < 40%: hp-red
    • Percentage (right): JetBrains Mono 700, 11px, same color as fill
    • Smooth animation on value change: width transition 400ms ease-out
    • For C3 MVP: utilization = (time agent was active in last 24h / 24h) * 100. Can be approximated from status polling data.

  3. Current Quest (bottom)

    • ">" prefix in text-muted (small RPG prompt feel)
    • Quest text: Space Grotesk 400, 12px, text-primary
    • Max 1 line, overflow ellipsis
    • If no active task: "Idle" in text-muted, italic

Agent Deep-Dive (Click-Through)

When you click a Party Screen card, the left column transitions to show that agent's full detail:

Layout:

+------------------------------------+
| [< Back to Party]                  |
|                                    |
| [Avatar 56px]  Bobby    LV 7      |
|                Web Dev             |
|                                    |
| HP [========================] 85%  |
| XP [================------] 2847  |
|                                    |
| CURRENT QUEST                      |
| Rebuild /v2 to audit standard      |
| Status: IN PROGRESS  2h elapsed    |
|                                    |
| VITALS                             |
| Tasks completed (7d):  12          |
| Commits (7d):          28          |
| Handoffs received:     4           |
| Handoffs sent:         6           |
| Avg task duration:     2.4h        |
| Uptime (24h):          18h         |
|                                    |
| RECENT COMPLETIONS                 |
| [x] Ship /case-study     1d ago   |
| [x] Fix /briefs bugs     2d ago   |
| [x] Deploy shared nav    3d ago   |
+------------------------------------+

Back button:

  • "< Back to Party" in Space Grotesk 400, 12px, text-secondary
  • Hover: text-primary
  • Click: returns to Party Screen grid

Agent Header:

  • SpriteAvatar: 56px
  • Same name/role/level as card but larger
  • XP bar (second bar below HP):
    • Label: "XP"
    • Shows progress toward next level
    • Fill color: accent-gold
    • For C3: placeholder bar at 0%

Vitals Section:

  • "VITALS" section title in Syne 800, 12px, accent-gold
  • Grid: 2 columns, stat-label on left, stat-value on right
  • Stat label: JetBrains Mono 500, 10px, text-muted
  • Stat value: JetBrains Mono 700, 14px, text-primary
  • Data from: agent status API + task history

Recent Completions:

  • List of last 5 completed tasks
  • Same styling as Checklist done items but smaller (12px font)
  • Checkbox + line-through text + timestamp

Quest Log (Right Column)

All active missions across all agents, sorted by priority.

Section Header

  • Title: "QUEST LOG" in Syne 800, 14px, accent-gold, uppercase
  • Filter pills: "All" | "Active" | "Blocked" | "Queued"
    • Default: "Active"
    • Pill styling: same as Checklist agent chips but smaller
    • Active pill: accent-gold bg at 10%, border accent-gold at 20%

Quest Item

Each quest is an active task from any agent.

Container:

  • Padding: 12px 14px
  • Border-bottom: 1px solid border-subtle
  • Display: flex, gap: 10px
  • Cursor: pointer
  • Hover: background bg-card-hover

Layout:

[Avatar 24px]  Rebuild /v2 to audit standard
               Bobby  IN PROGRESS  2h elapsed
  1. SpriteAvatar: 24px, agentColor border
  2. Quest Text: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, text-primary. Max 1 line, ellipsis.
  3. Meta Row (below text):
    • Agent name: JetBrains Mono 500, 9px, agentColor, uppercase
    • Status pill: same as everywhere (9px, uppercase, colored background)
    • Time elapsed: JetBrains Mono 400, 9px, text-muted
  4. Click: Opens agent deep-dive in the left column

Quest Log Scroll

  • Independent scroll from the left column
  • Max items: no limit, but pagination or virtual scroll if > 50 items
  • Empty state: "All quests complete. Your team is idle." in text-secondary, centered

Mission Feed (Bottom-Left)

Real-time event stream. Pipeline activity.

Section Header

  • Title: "MISSION FEED" in Syne 800, 14px, accent-gold, uppercase
  • "LIVE" badge (right side): green dot (6px, #22C55E, pulsing) + "LIVE" text (JetBrains Mono 600, 8px, #22C55E, uppercase)

Event Item

Each event is a pipeline action: commit, task completion, handoff, error.

Container:

  • Height: auto, min-height 32px
  • Display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 8px
  • Padding: 6px 0
  • Border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) (barely visible)

Layout:

[icon]  Bobby committed: Fix shared nav footer   2m ago

  1. Event Type Icon (16px):

    Event Icon Color
    task_complete CheckCircle2 #22C55E
    commit GitCommit #3B82F6
    handoff ArrowRight or Send #F59E0B
    error_recovery AlertTriangle #EF4444
    system Terminal #6B7280

  2. Event Text: Space Grotesk 400, 12px, text-secondary

    • Agent name in agentColor (bold)
    • Action verb in text-secondary
    • Object in text-primary
    • Format: "[Agent] [action]: [object]"

  3. Timestamp: JetBrains Mono 400, 9px, text-muted, right-aligned

New Event Animation

  • New events appear at the top
  • Slide in from left: translateX(-20px) to translateX(0), 200ms ease-out
  • Brief highlight: background flashes accent-gold at 5% then fades (300ms)
  • Max visible: last 20 events, scroll for more

Mobile Layout (< 768px)

On mobile, the three sections stack vertically:

Layout Order

  1. Party Screen (horizontal scrollable cards)
  2. Quest Log (collapsible)
  3. Mission Feed (collapsible)

Party Screen on Mobile

  • Horizontal scroll, not grid
  • Cards are 160px wide, 140px tall
  • Scroll-snap-type: x mandatory
  • Scroll-snap-align: start
  • Show 2.2 cards at once (peek the next card to invite scrolling)
  • Padding: 12px

Quest Log on Mobile

  • Collapsible section with chevron toggle
  • Default: expanded, showing top 5 quests
  • "Show all" button at bottom
  • Full-width items

Mission Feed on Mobile

  • Collapsible section
  • Default: collapsed (save space, mission feed is secondary on mobile)
  • When expanded: last 10 events

Tablet Layout (768-1023px)

  • Same as desktop but:
    • Party Screen: 3 columns instead of 4
    • Right column (Quest Log): 280px wide
    • Mission Feed: 2-column event layout if space allows

Ambient Details (The RPG Feel)

These small touches make the Megaboard feel like a game menu:

  1. Scanline overlay (optional, very subtle):

    • Repeating 2px transparent/1px rgba(0,0,0,0.03) horizontal lines
    • Gives a subtle CRT/retro feel
    • Toggle-able (some users may find it distracting)
    • OFF by default

  2. Card border glow on active agents:

    • 1px agentColor border at 15% opacity on cards where agent is working
    • Plus a very subtle box-shadow: 0 0 8px agentColor at 8%
    • Only on active agents, not idle

  3. Level-up animation (future, C4):

    • When an agent levels up: gold particle burst + level badge pulse
    • Sound effect (opt-in)
    • This is data-layer only in C3 (XP accumulates, no UI yet)

  4. HP bar pulse when low:

    • When utilization < 20%: the red HP bar pulses slowly (opacity 0.6 to 1.0, 2s)
    • Draws attention to underutilized agents

  5. Quest completion animation:

    • When a quest completes via WebSocket: the quest item in Quest Log gets a green checkmark slide-in (200ms)
    • Card briefly flashes green at 5% (200ms)
    • Then the quest fades out and slides to "completed" (if we add that section)

Data Sources (for Bobby)

Section Data Source Update Trigger
Party Screen - Name/Role gridSpec.js AGENTS array Static
Party Screen - Status /api/dashboard/status or WebSocket agent_state_change Real-time
Party Screen - HP/Utilization Computed from status history (last 24h active vs idle time) Every 60s
Party Screen - Level Supabase xp_totals (C3: placeholder) On task_complete event
Party Screen - Current Quest agentStatus.currentTask Real-time
Quest Log Supabase tasks table, status != 'done' Real-time via WebSocket
Mission Feed WebSocket events (all types) Real-time push
Agent Vitals Computed from task history + status history On demand (when deep-dive opens)

The Megaboard is where Corner flexes. It's the view that makes someone say "I've never seen a business tool that looks like this." Bobby builds it in Step 5. Make it feel like a game. Keep the data real.
